high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a presentation slide titled "11. Samsung shows tiny models can beat giants on reasoning." The slide highlights the performance of Samsung's 7M-parameter Tiny Recursion Model (TRM) on the ARC-AGI test, which it scores approximately 45% on, surpassing results from much larger models like Llama-3 8B, Qwen-7B, and baseline DeepSeek and Gemini entries. Below the title, there is a reference to a paper titled "Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks" by Alexia Jolicoeur-Martineau from Samsung
